verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a JavaScript or Python code step that runs inside a Zap workflow. The Platform CLI (Node.js) and the SDK are for building integrations or calling actions from outside Zapier, which are developer building blocks rather than an in-workflow code step. One community user also reports frustration at the lack of an option to write a couple of lines of code inside a Zap.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drop into real code (JavaScript or Python) as a step inside a workflow
